verdict.rationale: Asana's App Directory lists a Slack integration that turns Slack messages into Asana tasks and comments, and a GitHub integration that syncs pull request status to tasks. Google Drive has no specific native integration in the evidence; the only Google Workspace mention is a workflow-builder listing. missing for 10: a documented native Google Drive integration, confirmation that the Slack and GitHub listings are first-party native integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Turn ideas, work requests, and action items from Slack into trackable tasks and comments in Asana.
Automatically sync GitHub pull request status updates to Asana tasks.
Connect Asana with Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Zendesk, GitHub, GitLab, monday.com, Wrike, or another Asana project.
